title: A peaceful home with different moods

captions.emotions: Seeking a measure that suits both

meaning: Clear domestic routines help accommodate different needs when they are not expected to produce an equally bright mood every evening.
text: Domestic organisation can give you room to live peacefully beside each other: responsibilities clear, essentials anticipated and time reserved for rest. The Emperor in the physical position of Muladhara describes creating this foundation. The Sun in energy tests it through demanding continuous wellbeing: if home is arranged well, the evening must bring delight. Temperance in emotions seeks a suitable measure and agreement between different states. This combination needs room for tiredness, interest and quiet within one home, rather than feelings being fitted into a prepared picture.

For example, dinner is ready on time, yet afterwards one wish is conversation and another is silence. Trying to brighten the atmosphere immediately only strengthens the difference. **Shared peace does not require equally bright feelings.** You can preserve a thoughtfully arranged evening while allowing it to be gentler and quieter than intended. Organisation then supports rest, and agreement grows through a suitable amount of company instead of an obligation for both to feel equally good immediately.

The difficulty is treating any difference of mood as proof that the domestic plan failed. You change details, try harder and seek the proper response. Agreement becomes another job on top of work already finished. Comfort offers more stability when care can be received in your own state, without continually proving there are no difficulties between you.
